distribution.narrative: Zheng et al. (2019) describes Cryphalus eriobotryae from Dongshan, Suzhou, Jiangsu, and documents a severe outbreak in loquat plantations during 2018–2019. Jiangsu is therefore treated as confirmed mainland-China occurrence.

host_note: The holotype and paratypes were collected ex Eriobotrya japonica, and the source documents all life stages, galleries, cankers and mortality on loquat. Eriobotrya japonica is therefore a confirmed current host. The paper notes no obvious fungal pathogen but did not systematically investigate pathogens; this is not interpreted as evidence of pathogen/symbiont absence.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus eriobotryae Johnson, 2019.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus eriobotryae
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Cryphalus eriobotryae Johnson was described as a new species in 2019. Original-description evidence maps directly to the pre-existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_1688; no duplicate VSN is created.
